run.cluster: Aurora PostgreSQL 18.3, Serverless v2 at 8 ACU (minimum = maximum), one writer, us-east-1, through the RDS Data API
order: RebootDBInstance, then the hybrid queries again (hybrid_after_reboot)

notes: Cold means stop and start. After RebootDBInstance (postmaster started 15:15:21 UTC), every first query hit Aurora's buffer cache: hybrid_after_reboot shows shared hit and no read, so those numbers are warm. hybrid_cold ran after StopDBCluster and StartDBCluster: stopped after 527 s, available after 397 s, postmaster started 2026-10-13 15:29:15 UTC.
The cold fused query ran third, after the vector and full-text branches had read their pages (shared hit=5302 read=37), so it is not a cold figure; only the vector and full-text cold numbers are.
Timings are server-side Execution Time from EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS). lab_check times are medians of five runs; hybrid_warm is three runs in one session.

lab_check modes: exact orders by (embedding <=> reference) + 0, an expression no index serves; off sets enable_seqscan off, hnsw.ef_search 40 and hnsw.iterative_scan off; strict sets the same with hnsw.iterative_scan strict_order; planner sets nothing. Each mode runs in its own transaction, rolled back. The variants use the primary-key lookup of the Linen Photo Album (product 78); their sql field holds the exact settings and statement of each mode.

versions read hnsw.iterative_scan = off in its Data API session, and pg_database_size 8193 kB before the load. Every measured query sets hnsw.iterative_scan itself except lab_check's planner column. shared_buffers 1392640 is in 8 kB pages (10.6 GiB).

The selective-filter rows: at price <= 8 (905 matching products) a single HNSW pass with iterative scan off returns 0 rows and strict_order returns 20, the same 20 as the exact scan; at price <= 5 (67 matching) strict_order returns 20 rows but not the exact 20. hnsw.ef_search sets how many candidates one pass considers; iterative scan keeps scanning until the LIMIT is met or it has visited hnsw.max_scan_tuples tuples (pgvector's setting, not read in this run); neither promises the exact neighbours.

        Order By: (embedding <=> (InitPlan 1).col1)
        Filter: ((price <= '35'::numeric) AND (NOT (tags ? 'candle'::text)))

hybrid_sql.vector:
WITH query_embedding AS (
                SELECT (SELECT emb FROM lt.q WHERE name = 'anna') AS emb
            )
            SELECT
                "productId" AS product_id,
                name,
                brand,
                color,
                description,
                "imgUrl"   AS img_url,
                category,
                price,
                rating,
                reviews,
                badge,
                tags,
                materials,
                quantity,
                updated_at,
                1 - (embedding <=> (SELECT emb FROM query_embedding)) AS similarity
            FROM pellier.product_catalog
            WHERE "imgUrl" IS NOT NULL
              AND price <= 100.0
              AND quantity > 0
              AND NOT (tags ?| ARRAY['candle'] OR materials ?| ARRAY['candle'])
            ORDER BY embedding <=> (SELECT emb FROM query_embedding)
            LIMIT 20
hybrid_sql.fts:
WITH q AS (
                SELECT to_tsquery('english', 'housewarming | gift | friend | slow | mornings | stock | under | 100 | candles') AS ts_q
            )
            SELECT
                "productId" AS product_id,
                name,
                brand,
                color,
                description,
                "imgUrl"   AS img_url,
                category,
                price,
                rating,
                reviews,
                badge,
                tags,
                materials,
                quantity,
                updated_at,
                ts_rank_cd(description_tsv, q.ts_q) AS fts_rank_score
            FROM pellier.product_catalog
            CROSS JOIN q
            WHERE "imgUrl" IS NOT NULL
              AND description_tsv @@ q.ts_q
              AND price <= 100.0
              AND quantity > 0
              AND NOT (tags ?| ARRAY['candle'] OR materials ?| ARRAY['candle'])
            ORDER BY fts_rank_score DESC
            LIMIT 20
hybrid_sql.fused:
WITH query_embedding AS (SELECT emb FROM lt.q WHERE name = 'anna'),
t AS (SELECT product_id, row_number() OVER () AS r FROM (SELECT "productId" AS product_id FROM pellier.product_catalog
       WHERE "imgUrl" IS NOT NULL AND price <= 100.0 AND quantity > 0 AND NOT (tags ?| ARRAY['candle'] OR materials ?| ARRAY['candle']) ORDER BY embedding <=> (SELECT emb FROM query_embedding) LIMIT 20) v),
f AS (SELECT product_id, row_number() OVER () AS r FROM (SELECT "productId" AS product_id FROM pellier.product_catalog,
       to_tsquery('english', 'housewarming | gift | friend | slow | mornings | stock | under | 100 | candles') q WHERE "imgUrl" IS NOT NULL AND price <= 100.0 AND quantity > 0 AND NOT (tags ?| ARRAY['candle'] OR materials ?| ARRAY['candle']) AND description_tsv @@ q
       ORDER BY ts_rank_cd(description_tsv, q) DESC LIMIT 20) w)
SELECT coalesce(t.product_id, f.product_id) AS product_id, p.name,
       coalesce(1.0 / (60 + t.r), 0) + coalesce(1.0 / (60 + f.r), 0) AS rrf_score
  FROM t FULL JOIN f ON f.product_id = t.product_id
  JOIN pellier.product_catalog p ON p."productId" = coalesce(t.product_id, f.product_id)
 ORDER BY rrf_score DESC, coalesce(t.product_id, f.product_id) LIMIT 20
